metadata.description: The release-pr drafting journey over a fixture workspace: the real release-plz.toml and the held release-plz, against a loopback registry. It reads no crate of this workspace and no other project's tests, so its one edge is repo-checks, whose expect and shell vocabulary every suite here is written in; release-plz.toml is a root file no project owns, so a change to it reaches the whole graph and this journey with it.

typecheck.command: uv run -q ty check tests/release-drafting && uv run -q ty check --python-platform win32 tests/release-drafting
